system.description:
The target may select one skill with [Timing: n/Scene] that they have already used, and recover one use of that skill. A target who could not recover a use of a skill instead gains +1 [Fate Point]. You may not target yourself with this skill.

A magic that connects you with your allies through an invisible path that stretches across the battlefield like a net, and distributes magical power. Allies regain their vitality in no time and gain full strength.
